mission.name: idea-garnet-l0-evidence-durability
mission.tagline: Lane 0 evidence and changed-path verification must remain deterministic in fresh Windows and Unix clones without hidden
mission.northStar: A fresh Windows clone with default core.autocrlf passes the Lane 0 closeout gate without fetching pull-request refs; A fresh macOS or Linux clone passes the same gate without fetching pull-request refs; Every Lane 0 evidence worktree byte hash equals its authoritative Git object hash on both platforms

policies.notes: review until dogfood band 5 is routine; then auto.

phases.title: Checkout-fidelity repair
phases.goal: Protect every ops lane evidence directory from platform newline conversion while preserving committed object bytes.

phases.title: Main-reachable changed-path proof
phases.goal: Preserve candidate provenance while deriving changed-path content proof only from the landed commit and base on upstream main.

gates.title: Lane 0 closeout gate passes without pull refs

phases.title: Clean-clone and trust closeout
phases.goal: Capture fresh Windows and Unix clone proofs, verify the trust-kernel companion, and prepare one human-merged repair PR.

risks.title: A superficially green repair could still depend on an ambient Git object or silently weaken the sealed evidence proof.
